content.auratypeDescription: A quiet bilingual Vietnamese–English typing studio featuring grapheme-aware Telex/VNI input, Ghost replay, server-side Gemini AI passage generation, and local IndexedDB progress.
content.orbisDescription: Autonomous AI Desktop Companion built with Rust & Tauri, pairing Hybrid LLM (local Ollama & Cloud) with a floating HUD overlay.
content.nimboraDescription: An AI Agent workspace where agents and people work together.
content.antigravityModDescription: Unofficial UI customization & full Vietnamese localization mod for Google Antigravity 2.0, featuring an interactive 3D Chibi Furina companion (Three.js/WebGL) with real-time caret tracking.
